github_token_missing.cause: The configured GitHub token is unavailable.
github_token_missing.fix: Set the manifest-declared GitHub token environment variable and retry.

gmail_grant_missing.cause: No Gmail grant exists for this principal.

keychain_missing.cause: The Keychain command could not be found.
keychain_missing.fix: Restore `/usr/bin/security` on a supported macOS host and retry.

keychain_locked.cause: The stored integration grant cannot be read while Keychain is locked.
keychain_locked.fix: Unlock the login Keychain and retry.

keychain_corrupt.problem: The stored Gmail grant is invalid.
keychain_corrupt.cause: The Keychain entry is corrupt or incomplete.
keychain_corrupt.fix: Disconnect Gmail locally, then reconnect with the same principal.

keychain_unsupported.problem: Secure Gmail grant storage is unsupported.
keychain_unsupported.cause: This host cannot provide the required macOS Keychain boundary.
keychain_unsupported.fix: Use a supported macOS host; do not fall back to plaintext storage.

gmail_scope_drift.problem: The Gmail grant no longer has the required scopes.
gmail_scope_drift.cause: Stored and required OAuth scopes differ.
gmail_scope_drift.fix: Run `kaji connect gmail --principal <same-principal>` and consent again.

policy_rejected.problem: The integration request was rejected before dispatch.
policy_rejected.cause: A fixed-origin, repository, recipient, or schema policy did not match.
policy_rejected.fix: Review the integration allowlist and request shape before retrying.

api_rejected.problem: The provider rejected the integration request.
api_rejected.cause: The provider returned a confirmed non-retryable API rejection.
api_rejected.fix: Review the request against the provider response guidance before retrying manually.

transient_read_failed.problem: The integration read did not complete.
transient_read_failed.cause: The provider returned a transient failure before any external effect.
transient_read_failed.fix: Retry the idempotent read with bounded backoff.

rate_limited.problem: The provider rate limit was reached.
rate_limited.cause: The provider confirmed that this request was rate limited.
rate_limited.fix: Reduce parallelism and retry only after the bounded provider delay.

redirect_rejected.problem: The provider returned a redirect that Kaji will not follow.
redirect_rejected.cause: Fixed-origin integration requests reject every redirect.
redirect_rejected.fix: Verify the provider endpoint; do not retry an ambiguous mutation blindly.

response_limit_exceeded.problem: The integration response exceeded a safety bound.
response_limit_exceeded.cause: Provider headers or body were malformed or too large.
response_limit_exceeded.fix: Narrow the read request; reconcile a mutation before any retry.

github_mutation_unknown.problem: The GitHub mutation outcome is unknown.
github_mutation_unknown.cause: The connection failed after dispatch without a confirmed provider result.
github_mutation_unknown.fix: Reconcile the GitHub issue or comment marker before any manual retry.

gmail_mutation_unknown.problem: The Gmail mutation outcome is unknown.
gmail_mutation_unknown.cause: The connection failed after dispatch without a confirmed provider result.
gmail_mutation_unknown.fix: Reconcile the Gmail draft key or sent message before any manual retry.
